products.title: Turnkey Pre-Engineered Steel Buildings (PEB)
products.shortDescription: Complete design, 3D structural engineering, precision fabrication and rapid erection of custom Pre-Engineered Steel Buildings.
products.description: Winsteel Engineering Works is an industry-leading manufacturer of turnkey Pre-Engineered Buildings (PEB). We design, engineer, fabricate and erect state-of-the-art PEB structures for heavy manufacturing plants, logistics hubs, automotive complexes, and commercial facilities. Utilizing high-tensile steel (IS 2062 / ASTM A572 Grade 50), automated submerged arc welding, and precision CNC cold-formed C/Z purlins, our PEB structures provide up to 90m clear-span column-free space, 40% faster erection than conventional concrete, and superior seismic and wind resistance.
features: Clear span designs up to 90 meters without intermediate columns for maximum floor flexibility
100% custom-engineered to site dimensions, wind speeds up to 200 km/h, and seismic zone requirements
Manufactured with high-tensile IS 2062 E350/E450 steel with automated submerged arc welding (SAW)
Integrated crane runway systems supporting 5T to 100T heavy-duty EOT cranes
Energy-efficient insulated sandwich panel roofing, continuous ridge ventilators, and polycarbonate skylights

Designed to support heavy overhead EOT cranes, automated storage and retrieval systems (ASRS), mezzanine floors, and multi-bay dock levelers, our warehouses are built to withstand rigorous industrial operational cycles.

Heavy-duty EOT crane girder design from 10 MT to 80 MT capacity
Continuous gravity ridge monitors and power turbo ventilators for natural air circulation
Polycarbonate daylight skylight strips reducing daytime lighting costs by up to 60%
Engineered dock-leveler pits and wide canopy projections for 24/7 all-weather logistics

products.title: Multi-Storey Commercial & Industrial Steel Buildings
products.shortDescription: Fast-track multi-level commercial complexes, IT parks, factory mezzanine structures, and heavy industrial towers.
products.description: Modern commercial and high-density industrial facilities demand rapid construction speed, large column-free interior floor plates, and flexible architectural aesthetics. Up to 50% faster floor-by-floor cycle completion compared to conventional concrete frame
Flexible column grids allowing adaptable open-plan commercial floor plates
Factory-applied fireproof intumescent coating meeting 2-hour and 4-hour fire ratings
Service penetrations pre-engineered into castellated beams for seamless HVAC routing

products.shortDescription: High-capacity overhead launching gantry engineered for rapid span-by-span precast segmental bridge and viaduct erection.

Manufactured under strict ISO 3834-2 welding quality tolerances, these gantries incorporate electro-hydraulic self-launching mechanisms, heavy-duty winch trolleys, and integrated computerized load-monitoring systems that ensure peak operational safety and millimeter-accurate alignment.
features: Span lengths from 30m to 60m with lifting capacities up to 1,800 Metric Tonnes

Multi-point tensioning and micro-adjustment suspension bars for horizontal & vertical curves
Heavy-duty wind locks and dual safety braking systems on all hoisting winches
Modular box-girder main truss design facilitating straightforward jobsite transport and reassembly

products.title: Movable Scaffolding System (MSS) - Overhead & Underslung
products.shortDescription: Advanced in-situ bridge casting solution designed for cast-in-place concrete box girders across demanding terrains.
products.description: Winsteel Movable Scaffolding Systems (MSS) provide an autonomous, self-advancing falsework solution for casting continuous in-situ concrete spans without touching the ground below. Ideal for deep valleys, water crossings, and congested urban zones where ground scaffolding is impractical. Engineered with finite element structural analysis (FEA), the MSS guarantees minimal deflection during pour sequences and rapid self-launching between bridge piers.

Integrated hydraulic stripping and opening system for swift formwork release
Custom radius and super-elevation compensation mechanisms
Robust seal profiles preventing grout loss and honeycombing
Equipped with motorized launch trollies and synchronized hydraulic push cylinders

news.title: Winsteel Successfully Delivers Next-Gen 1,800 MT Automated Launching Gantry
news.author: Engineering Desk
news.shortDescription: Flagship 1,800 MT span-by-span launching gantry passes stringent trial erection and is dispatched for a major coastal expressway project.
news.content: Winsteel Engineering Works has achieved another breakthrough milestone with the fabrication and workshop trial assembly of its highest-capacity launching gantry to date. Commissioned for a critical coastal elevated transit corridor, the 1,800 MT overhead gantry features full PLC-guided self-launching hydraulic circuits and real-time load telemetry. Over 250 engineers and technicians collaborated at the Taloja manufacturing facility to conclude trial tests in record time.

news.title: Expansion of Taloja Facility: 35,000 Sq. Ft. Precision CNC Machining Bay Commissioned
news.author: Corporate Communications
news.shortDescription: New climate-controlled bay equipped with double-housing plano-millers and 12-meter floor borers to meet surging infrastructure demand.
news.content: To meet accelerating demand from bullet train and metro corridor projects across India and the Middle East, Winsteel Engineering Works has inaugurated its new Heavy Machining Division. Featuring high-precision Italian and Japanese CNC floor borers, the new unit expands internal machining capacity by 45%, ensuring that high-tolerance gantry hinge pins and match-mould flanges are finished strictly in-house under controlled temperature conditions.

news.title: Innovations in Underwater Tunnel Formwork: Achieving Zero Deflection Concrete Linings
news.author: Chief Technical Officer
news.shortDescription: A technical white paper on finite element dynamic modeling for heavy subterranean tunnel formworks subject to high hydrostatic pressure.
news.content: Winsteel's R&D department has published a comprehensive technical brief detailing advanced structural solutions for deep sub-aqueous tunnel linings. Through finite element analysis (FEA) and specialized multi-point hydraulic lockouts, Winsteel's latest tunnel gantries neutralize concrete hydrostatic thrust of up to 120 kN/m², guaranteeing crack-free, monolithic subterranean arches.

news.title: Winsteel Renews ISO 3834-2 & EN 1090-2 EXC4 Global Welding Accreditations
news.author: QA Division
news.shortDescription: Independent international audit confirms highest tier fusion welding competence and structural fabrication compliance.
news.content: Following a rigorous multi-week audit by TÜV NORD and DNV GL, Winsteel Engineering Works has successfully renewed its EN 1090-2 Execution Class 4 (EXC4) and ISO 3834-2 welding quality management certifications. This achievement reinforces Winsteel's capability to deliver bridge superstructures and nuclear safety containment steelwork conforming to the strictest global codes.
